subject.title: Inject sibling agent list into session system prompt

question: Should OpenClaw expose a sibling-agent roster with identity/theme and A2A reachability to model-visible prompt or tool context, and if so through which gated surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the metadata would reveal operator agent topology and permission state; automation cannot choose the product/security boundary or decide prompt injection versus tool discovery safely.

options.title: Use gated discovery tool output
options.body: Expose minimal roster metadata only for agents already visible to the requester through an approved agents_list-style contract, coordinating with the description and A2A scoping threads.

options.title: Inject a prompt roster
options.body: Add a system-prompt section for allowed siblings, accepting the prompt-cache and always-model-visible exposure tradeoff.

options.title: Defer or reject core roster exposure
options.body: Keep manual documentation or narrower linked features until maintainers want a broader multi-agent roster contract.

recommendation.title: Use gated discovery tool output
recommendation.body: Expose minimal roster metadata only for agents already visible to the requester through an approved agents_list-style contract, coordinating with the description and A2A scoping threads.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest feature-history signal for agents_list and multi-agent config/routing, the central surfaces for the decision.
